description: This file defines a template class 'MessageDataBufferType' within the 'WPEFramework::Messaging' namespace. It manages inter-process communication buffers, including a nested 'DataBuffer' class that handles cyclic buffers with doorbell signaling for synchronization. The class provides methods for pushing and popping data, waiting for signals, and managing buffer lifecycle, with configuration based on filenames and socket ports.

classes.name: MessageDataBufferType
classes.description: A template class managing message buffers with synchronization via doorbells, supporting data push/pop, waiting, and buffer lifecycle management.

classes.name: DataBuffer
classes.description: A nested class within 'MessageDataBufferType' that extends 'Core::CyclicBuffer' to handle data signaling and buffer operations with doorbell integration.

methods.name: PushData
methods.description: Writes data into the cyclic buffer, signaling the other side after completion.

methods.name: PopData
methods.description: Reads data from the cyclic buffer after a doorbell ring, handling partial messages if necessary.

methods.name: Ring
methods.description: Signals that data is available by ringing the doorbell.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the doorbell signal within a specified timeout.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the cyclic buffer is valid.

methods.name: MetadataName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with metadata.
